title: Incentives Shape How Humans Co-Create with Generative AI
abstract: arXiv:2604.03529v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Generative AI is quickly becoming an integral part of people's everyday workflows. Early evidence has shown that while generative AI can increase individual-level productivity, it does so at the cost of collective diversity, potentially narrowing the set of ideas and perspectives produced. Our research stands in contrast to this concern: through two pre-registered randomized control trials, we show that incentives can moderate AI's homogenizing force in two creative writing tasks where participants can use AI interactively. Participants rewarded for originality relative to peers produce collectively more diverse writing than those rewarded for quality alone. These participants continued to engage with AI, but ultimately incorporated less AI-generated text verbatim. translated_title: 激励机制塑造人类与生成式AI共创的方式
translated_abstract: 生成式AI正迅速成为人们日常工作流程中不可或缺的一部分。早期证据表明，虽然生成式AI能够提升个人层面的生产力，但这是以牺牲集体多样性为代价的，可能会缩小所产生想法和观点的范围。我们的研究与这一担忧形成鲜明对比：通过两项预注册的随机对照试验，我们发现在两个参与者可以交互式使用AI的创意写作任务中，激励机制能够调节AI的同质化力量。与仅因质量而获得奖励的参与者相比，因原创性相对同伴获得奖励的参与者创作出集体上更加多样化的作品。这些参与者仍然持续与AI互动，但最终逐字采纳的AI生成文本更少。我们的研究结果表明，生成式AI的影响不仅取决于技术本身，还取决于围绕该技术的行为策略和激励机制。
tldr: 通过两项随机对照试验，研究发现激励机制能够调节生成式AI的同质化效应——奖励原创性的参与者在创意写作中产生了更集体多样化的作品，并且更少逐字采纳AI生成的文本。
en_tdlr: Through two randomized control trials, this study shows that incentives can moderate generative AI's homogenizing force—participants rewarded for originality produce collectively more diverse creative writing and incorporate less AI-generated text verbatim than those rewarded for quality alone.
